spec.description: S3-compatible object store.

spec.title: S3 requests
spec.description: Every S3 API request, errors included.

spec.title: Errors by operation and status
spec.description:
- `HeadObject 404` is a client checking whether an object exists yet.
- `GetObject 404` is a read of an object that is not there.
- Other 4xx, `403` above all, are refused requests: a wrong key or missing permission.
- Any 5xx is garage failing.

spec.title: Block throughput
spec.description: Bytes as stored, after compression if it is enabled. Objects under 3 KiB are inlined into metadata and never appear here.

spec.title: Background queues
spec.description:
Summed across tables, peak per bucket.
- Garage holds deleted rows for 24 hours before purging them: a steady GC depth is the normal state.

spec.title: Device utilisation
spec.description: Share of time the disk had a request in flight. Sustained 100% means the device sets the latency, not garage.

spec.title: Running versions
spec.description: A version live at any point in a bucket fills it, so two rows overlap across an upgrade.

spec.title: Latency by operation
spec.description:
The histogram resolves 1 ms to 100 s; figures outside that band are interpolation.
- A `404` is mostly a client probing whether an object exists; a `403` is a refused request.
- Any 5xx is garage failing.

spec.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (api_endpoint, le) (rate(api_s3_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])))
and on (api_endpoint) (sum by (api_endpoint)(rate(api_s3_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (api_endpoint, le) (rate(api_s3_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])))
and on (api_endpoint) (sum by (api_endpoint)(rate(api_s3_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (api_endpoint) (increase(api_s3_error_counter{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname", status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]))
or
sum by (api_endpoint) (increase(api_s3_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range]) * 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (api_endpoint, le) (rate(api_s3_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval])))
and on (api_endpoint) (sum by (api_endpoint)(rate(api_s3_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

spec.title: Slow request share
spec.description:
Stacked, so the top edge is the share of requests over 100 ms.
- Every operation together; `UploadPart` carries a whole part and routinely lands above 100 ms.
- Max is the worst bucket; an average of per-bucket shares would overstate the range-wide share.

spec.title: Bytes read
spec.description: Objects under 3 KiB are inlined into metadata, never reach the block store, and are not counted here.

spec.title: Resync queue and errors
spec.description: Blocks awaiting a local integrity check, peak per bucket.

spec.title: Table size
spec.description:
Rows per metadata table on this node, empty tables hidden.
- `block_rc` counts distinct data blocks stored. Identical chunks deduplicate and objects under 3 KiB never become blocks, so it grows slower than `object`.

spec.title: Internal writes
spec.description: Rows changed in the metadata database, including garbage collection and repartitioning that no client asked for.

spec.title: Bytes written
spec.description: As stored, after compression if it is enabled.

spec.title: Store capacity
spec.description: The filesystem behind `data`. Garage reports the same figure for `metadata` when both sit on one volume.

spec.title: Used
spec.description: Everything on the filesystem, not garage alone.

spec.title: Free
spec.description: Of the `data` volume as the filesystem reports it, so anything else sharing that filesystem counts against it.

spec.title: Net growth
spec.description: Change in used space from the start of the visible range to its end, negative if the volume shrank. Anything else sharing the filesystem is counted too.

spec.title: Device utilisation and queue depth
spec.description: Utilisation is the share of time the device had a request in flight; queue depth, on the right axis, is how many were outstanding.

spec.title: Device await
spec.description: Mean time per completed request, queueing included. If this tracks the S3 latency on the Overview tab, the disk sets the pace, not garage.

spec.title: Device throughput
spec.description: Whole-host traffic, not garage alone. Metadata snapshots, when enabled, copy the entire database and appear as periodic write bursts.

spec.title: S3 write latency
spec.description:
`PutObject` only; multipart `UploadPart` excluded.
- The histogram tops out at 100 s; a p99 there means slower.

spec.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(api_s3_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname", api_endpoint="PutObject"}[$__rate_interval])))
and on () (sum(rate(api_s3_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname", api_endpoint="PutObject"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(api_s3_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname", api_endpoint="PutObject"}[$__rate_interval])))
and on () (sum(rate(api_s3_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname", api_endpoint="PutObject"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

spec.title: Requests by access key
spec.description: From the access log, so it can disagree slightly with `Overview · S3 requests`.

spec.title: Objects
spec.description: Rows in the `object` table; objects under 3 KiB live there in full.

spec.title: Requests by client and key
spec.description: Caller-and-credential pairs. The address is what garage recorded for the client.

Newest 1000 lines from the garage container, access and maintenance interleaved.
- Access lines read `<client> (via <proxy>) (key <credential>) <method> <path>`, without status or duration.

spec.expr:
{syslog_id="docker/garage", hostname=~"$hostname"}
| regexp `(?P<lvl>TRACE|DEBUG|INFO|WARN|ERROR)`
| label_format level=`{{ if .lvl }}{{ lower .lvl }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}`
| level =~ `$errors_only`
| drop lvl, detected_level, hostname, job, project, service_name, syslog_id, systemd_unit, transport

spec.title: Metadata GC
spec.description: Tombstoned rows the garbage collector queued for deletion, from the log.

spec.expr: sum by (table) (sum_over_time({syslog_id="docker/garage", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "GC: " | pattern `<_>(<table>) GC: <items> items<_>` | unwrap items | __error__="" [$__auto]))

sum by (level) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/garage", hostname=~"$hostname"}
| regexp `(?P<lvl>TRACE|DEBUG|INFO|WARN|ERROR)`
| label_format level=`{{ if .lvl }}{{ lower .lvl }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}`
| level =~ `$errors_only`
[$__interval]))

spec.title: Table reads
spec.description:
Metadata lookups; one S3 read walks `object` and `version` before any block.
- The histogram starts at 1 ms, so `990 µs` means faster than that.

spec.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (table_name, le) (rate(table_get_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])))
and on (table_name) (sum by (table_name)(rate(table_get_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (table_name, le) (rate(table_get_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])))
and on (table_name) (sum by (table_name)(rate(table_get_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (table_name, le) (rate(table_get_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval])))
and on (table_name) (sum by (table_name)(rate(table_get_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

spec.title: Table writes
spec.description:
One `PutObject` writes `object`, `version` and a `block_ref` per chunk.
- With metadata fsync on, every write is a durable transaction and its p99 follows the device await in `Disk & Host`.
- The histogram starts at 1 ms, so `990 µs` means faster than that.

spec.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (table_name, le) (rate(table_put_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])))
and on (table_name) (sum by (table_name)(rate(table_put_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (table_name, le) (rate(table_put_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])))
and on (table_name) (sum by (table_name)(rate(table_put_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (table_name, le) (rate(table_put_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval])))
and on (table_name) (sum by (table_name)(rate(table_put_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

spec.title: Block operations
spec.description:
One block at a time, 1 MiB by default. A single S3 read is several block reads plus the table reads above.
- The histogram starts at 1 ms, so `990 µs` means faster than that.

spec.expr:
label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(block_read_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range]))), "op", "Read", "", "")
or
label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(block_write_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range]))), "op", "Write", "", "")
or
label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(block_resync_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range]))), "op", "Resync", "", "")

label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(block_read_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range]))), "op", "Read", "", "")
or
label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(block_write_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range]))), "op", "Write", "", "")
or
label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(block_resync_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range]))), "op", "Resync", "", "")

label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(block_read_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval]))), "op", "Read", "", "")
or
label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(block_write_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval]))), "op", "Write", "", "")
or
label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(block_resync_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval]))), "op", "Resync", "", "")

spec.title: Block read latency
spec.description:
Block reads per duration bucket.
- The bottom band is the first bucket, 1 ms; nothing inside it can be separated.

spec.title: Store free
spec.description: Of the `data` volume as the filesystem reports it, so anything else sharing that filesystem counts against it.

spec.title: Error ratio
spec.description: 404 excluded.

spec.title: S3 requests and errors
spec.description: The request line counts every request, the errored ones included.

spec.title: S3 read latency
spec.description:
`GetObject` only; the S3 API tab has the other operations.
- The histogram tops out at 100 s; a p99 there means slower.

spec.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(api_s3_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname", api_endpoint="GetObject"}[$__rate_interval])))
and on () (sum(rate(api_s3_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname", api_endpoint="GetObject"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(api_s3_request_duration_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname", api_endpoint="GetObject"}[$__rate_interval])))
and on () (sum(rate(api_s3_request_duration_count{job="prometheus.scrape.garage", host=~"$hostname", api_endpoint="GetObject"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

spec.title: Store space
spec.description: Capacity is the whole filesystem, so anything else on it counts as used.

spec.title: Garage

spec.name: errors_only
spec.label: Errors only
spec.description: Show only warnings and errors in the log. Lines without a level are kept.
